title: notACMS _site.yaml
description: Site-wide configuration for a notACMS instance. All settings live under the top-level `site:` key. Core platform fields are documented here; themes may add additional keys freely.

name.description: Site display name. Used in og:site_name, <title> fallback, and RSS channel title.

description.description: Site-wide description. Used as og:description fallback and RSS channel description.

base_url.description: Canonical base URL without trailing slash, e.g. https://example.com. Used for sitemap, RSS, og:url, and must match the URL env var in production.

locales.description: Supported locales. Keys are BCP 47 locale codes (e.g. en, pl, de, fr). The first key is the default locale — its routes use no URL prefix. Additional locales are prefixed with /{code}/. Minimum one locale required.

author.description: Site author or owner. Core fields listed below; themes may add arbitrary keys (expertise, recommendations, open_source, skills, etc.) consumed in Twig templates.

name.description: Author display name. Used in RSS <author> and structured data.

initials.description: Short initials shown in avatar placeholder when no image is available.

email.description: Author contact email. May be an empty string to omit from output.

url.description: URL to author's about or profile page.

avatar.description: Path or URL to author avatar image.

social.description: Social profile links. Two shapes are supported depending on the active theme: a keyed object {platform: url} or an array of {name, url} objects.

oneOf.description: Keyed object: platform slug → absolute URL. E.g. github: https://github.com/you
Array of {name, url} objects for ordered or annotated social links.

name.description: Platform slug, e.g. github, linkedin, drupal.

url.description: Absolute URL to the profile page.

posts_per_page.description: Number of posts per page on blog listing and paginated archive pages. Default: 10.

rss_limit.description: Maximum number of posts included in the RSS feed. Default: 20.

recent_posts_limit.description: Number of posts shown in the recent posts sidebar widget. Default: 6.

related_posts_limit.description: Number of related posts shown at the bottom of a single post page. Default: 3.

new_post_days.description: A post published within this many days receives a NEW badge on post cards. Set to 0 to disable the badge entirely. Default: 90.

coming_soon_reveal_days.description: A scheduled post becomes visible in listings this many days before its publish date, showing a Coming Soon placeholder. Default: 14.

meta_description_length.description: Maximum character length for auto-generated meta description tags. Default: 160.

image_variant_widths.description: Pixel widths for responsive image variants generated during the static build. Default: [640, 960].

image_quality.description: WebP/JPEG quality (1–100) for generated image variants. Higher = better quality, larger files. Default: 82.

image_magick_flags.description: Extra ImageMagick convert flags appended to every image conversion command. Default: "-strip".

contact_form.description: Contact form mailer settings. Required when the contact route is active and RUNTIME_PHP_ENABLED=true.

email.description: Recipient email address for contact form submissions.

from.description: Sender address used in the From: header of outgoing emails.

from_name.description: Sender display name used in the From: header.

topic.description: Email subject prefix prepended to the user-supplied subject, e.g. [MySite].

localeConfig.description: Per-locale settings. Core fields listed; themes may add arbitrary keys (tagline_commands, font_preload, etc.) consumed directly in Twig templates.

label.description: Human-readable language name shown in the locale switcher, e.g. English, Polski, Deutsch.

og_locale.description: og:locale value in IETF format with underscore separator, e.g. en_US, pl_PL, de_DE.

date_format.description: PHP date() format string used to display post dates in this locale, e.g. M d, Y or d.m.Y.

tagline.description: Short site tagline shown in the hero or header area for this locale.
